newsitem.title: LEBANON: Banque Audi hits all-time high on Beirut bourse.
newsitem.headline: Banque Audi hits all-time high on Beirut bourse.

text.p: Banque Audi rose on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Friday to a new all-time high of $23.125.
The latest Audi rise brought to 54 percent the total increase in the share's price since it began trading at $15 on January 20. It traded at $23 on Thursday.
Demand exceeded supply for all active stocks except Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce. Demand for the share was 23,956 shares against a supply of 36,979. Only 4,335 orders were executed.
BLC fell to $17.625 from its record high $17.75. A block of 5,000 BLC shares traded on the BSE at $17.625.
Bank of Beirut rose to $3.6875 from $3.625. Two blocks totalling 50,000 shares changed hands on the floor at $3.6875 and $3.625.
Demand for A shares was 280,808 against a supply of 63,067 shares on the first fixing. As for B shares, demand was 115,250 on the same fixing against a supply of 22,358.
Solidere A shares rose to $10.5 from $10.375 while B shares were unchanged at $10.75.
The LIBX bank index rose 0.52 percent to 149.13. The LISPI general index rose 0.33 to 88.42 while the BLOM general index rose 0.66 percent to 930.88.
Total BSE turnover was 240,164 shares for a value of $1,858,718 against a turnover of 155,324 shares for $1,541,829 a day earlier.
Of the four industrial firms, pipemaker Eternit rose to $1.9375 from $1.875. Demand for the share was 72,500 against a supply of 10,500 -- 10,000 of which were executed.
There was no trade in either Ciments Blancs or tilemaker Uniceramic.
